definitionZh: 对话框是覆盖在主窗口或另一个对话框窗口上的窗口。模式对话框下的窗口是惰性的。也就是说，用户无法与活动对话窗口之外的内容进行交互。活动对话框外部的惰性内容通常在视觉上模糊或变暗，因此难以辨别，并且在一些实现中，尝试与惰性内容交互会导致对话框关闭。
sourceDefinition: A dialog is a window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window. Windows under a modal dialog are inert. That is, users cannot interact with content outside an active dialog window. Inert content outside an active dialog is typically visually obscured or dimmed so it is difficult to discern, and in some implementations, attempts to interact with the inert content cause the dialog to close.
